audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the mirror and with the whys on the same page — the page showed Yone or Skill through levels 1-5 while every why says Warwick crushes that stretch.
audit.why: The mirror set rows 0, 2, 3 and 4 to Warwick and row 1 to Skill; whys[0], whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], early and spikes[0] all describe Warwick owning levels 1-5.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 4 -> Warwick (3/10), row 1 -> Skill, each as a matched full+content pair; whys[1] rewritten so it agrees with its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 3, 4-5 and 6 phases carried no numbers, so 'trade around his cooldown' named no cooldown.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, Primal Howl is 15/14/13/12/11s giving 2.5s damage reduction then a 1s fear, and Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why, phases[3].why and phases[4].why rewritten around those timers and the Blood Hunt reveal threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Infinite Duress was written as an unanswerable 'all-in suppress' — the page never says it is a channel that CC cuts, and never says his healing scales as he drops.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is flagged channel (interruptible — any CC cancels it) and suppresses 1.5s; Eternal Hunger heals him below 50% health and triples below 25%; Jaws deals max-health damage, so stacking armour reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now states the 110s, the 1.5s suppress and that Q3's knockup cuts the channel; dontsFull[1].d states the passive heal thresholds and Grievous Wounds; breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with all three timers.

edits.before: At level 2 his sustain off your HP keeps him well ahead.
edits.after: Level 2 is close — his Q heal is 8s, so trade in that gap.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Warwick must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Blood Hunt reveals you under 50% and speeds him in; Jaws heals off your max HP every 8s. Trade only in that gap.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Infinite Duress's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Primal Howl gives him 2.5s of damage reduction and then a 1s fear, on 15s. Farm at range and hold for your first item spike.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Warwick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s and is 110s at rank 1 — your Q3 knockup cuts the channel if you have the stacks ready.

edits.before: His all-in suppress. Trade when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 110s at rank 1, 1.5s suppress, and it is a channel — Q3's knockup cuts it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His passive heals him below 50% and triples under 25%. Bring Grievous.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in suppress. Trade when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Infinite Duress (R): 110s at rank 1, 1.5s suppress, and it is a channel any CC cuts. - Primal Howl (E): 15s, 2.5s of damage reduction then a 1s fear. - Jaws of the Beast (Q): 8s, and it heals off your max HP.

notes: Row 1 follows the mirror (Skill), not the packet chart (Warwick) — the two disagree and the mirror is the binding side; whys[1] was rewritten to agree with the row rather than the row bent to the text. Restated from the mirror: Soul Unbound returns Yone's spirit to his body and repeats a portion of damage he DEALT — it does not undo damage taken, so it is not an escape from a losing trade.
